summary: A deployment configuration inspector that reports runtime facts and looks up named config values.

declared.rationale: A9 present-when: a tool returns environment values selected by caller input. get_config_value takes a caller-supplied 'name' and returns os.environ.get(name) with no allowlist, so the caller can read any variable in the process environment, not a fixed deployment-specific subset. This is the leak channel, distinct from A7 (a secret literal in source): there is no credential-shaped literal anywhere in this server, and the finding holds even when the environment happens to contain nothing sensitive at scan time, exactly as the taxonomy states for A9. The target is the environment block, not the filesystem (distinguishing it from A8).
